input.content: You are an independent PLC verification engineer. Return ONLY a JSON list of test cases.

You are an independent PLC test engineer. Generate comprehensive unit test cases for the specified PLC function block.
CODESYS Simulation Timing & Edge Rules:
- dt_ms advances elapsed PLC scan time for that step; TON/TOF timers accumulate dt_ms across consecutive steps while IN keeps its active state (e.g., IN=TRUE for TON).
- Rising-edge detection (R_TRIG or x AND NOT prev_x) requires a step with x=FALSE before the step with x=TRUE.

Return a JSON array of test case objects. Each test case must have:
- id: string identifier (e.g. 'case_1')
- steps: array of steps, where each step has:
    - inputs: dictionary of input variable names and values
    - expected: dictionary of expected output variable names and values
    - dt_ms: (optional) cycle elapsed time in milliseconds

TASK SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "SELF012",
  "title": "Bounded automatic fault retries with a recovery dwell",
  "difficulty": "hard",
  "requirements": "# SELF012: Fault-Tolerant Retry and Lockout Controller\n\n## Background\nFault-tolerant motor controller permitting up to 2 automatic restarts after a 2-scan fault-free dwell.\n\n## Functional Requirements\n1. Inputs: `Start`, `Stop`, `Fault`, `Reset` (`BOOL`). Internal state: `mode` (`IDLE`/`RUNNING`/`WAIT`/`LOCKED`), `Attempts` (`0..2`), `free_scans` (`0..2`).\n2. Valid reset (`Reset = TRUE AND Fault = FALSE AND Start = FALSE`) clears `mode := IDLE`, `Attempts := 0`, `free_scans := 0`.\n3. If already `LOCKED`, remain `LOCKED`. Else `Stop = TRUE` forces `mode := IDLE`, `free_scans := 0` while preserving `Attempts` across manual stop/restart.\n4. In `RUNNING`: if `Fault = TRUE`, enter `LOCKED` when `Attempts >= 2`, else enter `WAIT` with `free_scans := 0`.\n5. In `WAIT`: if `Fault = TRUE`, clear `free_scans := 0`; else increment `free_scans`, and when `free_scans >= 2`, increment `Attempts += 1`, clear `free_scans := 0`, and return to `RUNNING`.\n6. In `IDLE`: `Start = TRUE AND Fault = FALSE` enters `RUNNING` (keeping `Attempts`). Outputs match post-transition `mode`: `Run <-> RUNNING`, `Locked <-> LOCKED`, plus `Attempts`.\n\n## Interface\n- **Inputs:** `Start: BOOL`, `Stop: BOOL`, `Fault: BOOL`, `Reset: BOOL`\n- **Outputs:** `Run: BOOL`, `Locked: BOOL`, `Attempts: USINT`\n\n## Initial Values\n- `state=\"IDLE\"`, `Attempts=0`, `recovery_free_scans=0`, `Run=false`, `Locked=false`\n\n## Timing & Evaluation Conventions\nRetries use scan-level fault-free dwell (`free_scans >= 2`); each scan executes one step.",
  "scenario": "A laboratory feeder allows two automatic retries after a transient process fault and locks out a repeatedly failing actuator.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Start",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Operator start request"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Stop",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Abort without clearing retry count"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Fault",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Process fault"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Reset",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Clear retry history with Start released"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Run",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Feeder command"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Locked",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Retry exhaustion lockout"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Attempts",
      "type": "USINT",
      "description": "Automatic restarts issued, zero through two"
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "state": "IDLE",
    "Attempts": 0,
    "recovery_free_scans": 0,
    "Run": false,
    "Locked": false
  },
  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Valid reset",
    "Latched lockout",
    "Stop",
    "Running fault",
    "Recovery dwell",
    "Idle start"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The fault is an educational process input, not a personnel safety function.",
    "Operator stop/start does not restore the automatic retry budget; only accepted Reset does.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "Start": "I[k].Start: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Stop": "I[k].Stop: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Fault": "I[k].Fault: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Reset": "I[k].Reset: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Run": "O[k].Run: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Locked": "O[k].Locked: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Attempts": "O[k].Attempts: independently observed post-scan candidate value (USINT); never defined as expected output.",
    "first": "k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation",
    "qLocked": "Spre.reference.state.mode=3",
    "qRunning": "Spre.reference.state.mode=1",
    "qWait": "Spre.reference.state.mode=2",
    "qAttempts": "{\"kind\": \"previous_observed_output\", \"source\": \"O[k-1].Attempts\", \"initial\": 0, \"update\": \"After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].Attempts; never write into reference state.\"}",
    "validReset": "Reset & !Fault & !Start.",
    "retryDue": "Spre.reference.state.mode=2 AND NOT I[k].Fault AND Spre.reference.state.free>=1",
    "normal": "!validReset & !Stop.",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: Spre.mode=IDLE, O_init.Run=false, O_init.Locked=false, O_init.Attempts=0.",
    "qIdle": "Spre.reference.state.mode=0",
    "refAttempts": "Spre.reference.state.attempts"
  },
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "SELF012.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF012.P1",
      "formula": "G(Fault -> !Run)",
      "explanation": "A present fault cannot command the feeder.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF012.P2",
      "formula": "G((Attempts >= 0) & (Attempts <= 2))",
      "explanation": "Automatic restart count stays within the budget.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF012.P3",
      "formula": "G(validReset -> (!Run & !Locked & (Attempts = 0)))",
      "explanation": "Accepted reset clears history and leaves the feeder stopped.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF012.P4",
      "formula": "G((qLocked & !validReset) -> (Locked & !Run))",
      "explanation": "Lockout requires a safe explicit reset.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF012.P5",
      "formula": "G((qRunning & Fault & normal & (refAttempts = 2)) -> Locked)",
      "explanation": "Lock out on Fault from RUNNING once reference attempts already reached 2 (uses Spre.attempts to stay immune to candidate undercounting).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF012.P6",
      "formula": "G((retryDue & normal) -> (Run & (Attempts = refAttempts + 1)))",
      "explanation": "On fault-free retry dwell completion, restart Run and output Attempts = Spre.attempts + 1.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF012.P7",
      "formula": "G((qWait & Fault & normal) -> !Run)",
      "explanation": "A fault during recovery clears progress and prevents restart.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF012.P8",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "G(((qIdle & normal & !(Start & !Fault)) -> (!Run & !Locked & Attempts=refAttempts)) & ((qIdle & normal & Start & !Fault) -> (Run & !Locked & Attempts=refAttempts)) & ((qRunning & !Fault & normal) -> (Run & !Locked & Attempts=refAttempts)))",
      "description": "Covers IDLE hold, IDLE->RUNNING start, RUNNING normal continuation, and Attempts preservation across Start/Stop.",
      "explanation": "Eliminates vacuous under-counting and missing IDLE/RUNNING forward constraints.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF012.P9",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "G(((normal & qWait & !retryDue) -> (!Run & !Locked & Attempts=refAttempts)) & ((!qLocked & !(qRunning & Fault & normal & refAttempts=2)) -> !Locked) & (!(Run & Locked)))",
      "description": "Covers WAIT dwell holding, forbids premature Locked before exhausting 2 retries, and enforces Run/Locked exclusion.",
      "explanation": "Completes SELF012 independent safety closure.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ]
}
Output budget: at most 2 cases, at most 8 steps per case. Use compact JSON. Cover a complete normal path and one important boundary. Keep reasoning concise enough to finish the entire JSON within the output budget.
